title: backlog: .harness/config/backlog.json
description: Where the project's backlog lives and how the session protocol names things. The agent reads this file (the skill has no script); every key is optional and falls back to the adapter's defaults or to discovery through the MCP server. `$`-prefixed keys are comments.

provider.description: Adapter to use: references/adapter-<provider>.md in the skill. Default: autodetected (a connected MCP server matching a shipped adapter; `officium` is the one shipped today).

mcpServer.description: Name the MCP server is registered under in the client. Default: the adapter's default server name (`officium` for the Officium adapter).

mcpUrl.description: MCP endpoint; the `claude mcp add` / `codex mcp add` setup commands are derived from it. Default: none (the setup commands cannot be built without it).

boardUrl.description: Where people see the board; given to the user when a card needs their eyes. Default: none.

project.description: The tracker's project. Default: discovered through the MCP server (the user is asked when there is more than one).

id.description: The tracker's project identifier. Default: discovered.

name.description: Human name of the project. Default: discovered.

keyPrefix.description: Prefix of new card keys (`PROJ` for `PROJ-12`); lets the agent recognize this project's keys in commits and chat. Default: whatever the tracker assigns.

legacyKeyPrefixes.description: Older prefixes still valid on imported cards. Default: [].

statuses.description: The tracker's names for the protocol's statuses. A tracker without a `deploy` stage maps it to the same value as `done`. Default: {"backlog": "backlog", "doing": "doing", "review": "review", "deploy": "deploy", "done": "done"}.

sprints.description: "auto" uses sprints when the tracker has them and one is active; true requires them; false ignores them (step 4 skips the pull into the sprint). Default: "auto".

machineName.description: Where the `machine` value reported on runs comes from: "hostname" (the `hostname` command), "env:VAR" (an environment variable, for launchers that set one), or any other string, used literally. Default: "hostname".

statusReportMinutes.description: Longest silence between `reportStatus` calls. Keep it under the tracker's run lapse (10 minutes on Officium). Default: 10.

doneEvidence.description: When a card in `deploy` is done: "running" (verified in what production runs) or "merged" (in `mainBranch`, where merging is the project's deploy decision). Default: "running".

decisionPolicy.description: Path, relative to the harness directory, of the project rule that says which decisions still need a person. When set, a business decision it does not reserve for a person is the agent's (step 5), not a wall. Default: none, and every missing business decision is a wall.

codeReferences.description: How code, tests and commits reference cards, Apple Radar style (`card://PROJ-123`). Default: {"scheme": "card"}.

scheme.description: URI scheme of a reference: `<scheme>://<KEY>`. Default: "card".

urlTemplate.description: Link to a card with a `{key}` placeholder, printed next to each reference by scripts/card_refs.py. Default: none.

commitKey.description: How a commit names its card: "trailer" (a `Card: card://PROJ-123` line) or "subject" (the bare key at the end of the subject, `fix(ui): ... (PROJ-123)`). Default: "trailer".

ignore.description: Globs (relative to the project root; `*` stays in one folder, `**` crosses them) of tracked paths scripts/card_refs.py skips: vendored code, or a catalog whose examples use other projects' keys. Default: [].
